name: Cobalt Scarcity Penalty
description: Materials with high cobalt dependence should be flagged for supply-chain and cost risk at production scale.

name: Thermal Runaway Guardrail
description: Materials with elevated thermal instability should be flagged when safety margins are narrow for battery pack deployment.

name: High Ionic Conductivity Benefit
description: Materials with strong lithium-ion transport characteristics should be recognized as a positive performance signal.
